name: Nodots Backgammon API
description:
REST API for managing backgammon games, users, game history, performance ratings, and XG import functionality.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require Auth0 JWT authentication. Include the token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## Game Flow
1. Create game with two players (`POST /games`)
2. Game auto-transitions to `rolled-for-start` state
3. Roll dice (`POST /games/:id/roll`) → `moving` state
4. Make moves (`POST /games/:id/move`) until turn complete
5. Confirm turn (`POST /games/:id/confirm-turn`) → next player's turn
6. Repeat until game reaches `completed` state

## WebSocket
Real-time updates available via Socket.IO at the same host.
